digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow — GitHub Actions pytest gate
propositions: The macOS pytest job (macos-latest, py3.13) is the critical path of the Verified gate at 18.6m, with coverage collection accounting for 15.4m of that duration.

Coverage.py tracing on macOS is duplicate work: the identical 7856 tests and coverage floor (fail_under = 70) are already enforced three times over by ubuntu cells, but the macOS coverage report is never consumed.

The macOS runner pool is scarce (peak 4 concurrent), causing queuing delays up to 8.4m when multiple changes are dispatched; reducing macOS job duration directly reduces contention and overall gate runtime.

The change makes --cov flags conditional on OS in the test job default-suite step: ubuntu keeps coverage collection, macOS runs without it, preserving test execution and platform-compat coverage (flock/mkdir lock, gtimeout).
